repository.description: Canonical path of the routed repository.

status.description: Change-history index state for the requested landing branch.

repository.description: Stable repository identity recorded in the index.

database_path.description: Path of the rebuildable change-history SQLite database.

cursor.description: Last landing-branch tip indexed atomically, or null before the first complete sync.

bootstrap_tip.description: Frozen tip of an in-progress bounded bootstrap, or null.

bootstrap_resume_from.description: Oldest not-yet-visited commit the next bounded history_sync resumes from, or null.

complete.description: False while only a newest-first suffix of the frozen first-parent history is indexed.

verified_deliveries.description: Deliveries backed by verified public delivery evidence.

git_only_deliveries.description: Deliveries inferred only from first-parent Git history.

task_associations.description: Task memberships across deliveries; one delivery may associate several tasks.
